title: An $\widetilde{O}(n^3)$-time FPRAS for the Permanent
summary: We give an FPRAS for the permanent of an $n\times n$ $0/1$ matrix with running time $\widetilde O(n^3)$. Our algorithm extends to a strongly polynomial FPRAS for arbitrary nonnegative matrices with the same running-time bound (but in the unit-cost arithmetic model). Jerrum, Sinclair, and Vigoda (2004) gave the first FPRAS for the permanent of a nonnegative matrix. The running time was subsequently improved to $\widetilde{O}(n^7)$ by Bezáková, Štefankovič, Vazirani, and Vigoda (2008), and recently to $\widetilde{O}(n^6)$ by Chen, Vigoda, and Yang (2026).
